_comment: 河流城市「妮芙的三分钟」剧本（剧情姐合订稿 in1030/yun1.txt 第 73–152 行）。通讯器用 phone_* 步骤（docs/phone_and_cockpit_contract.md）：鹿借弥洛通讯器留言 river_msg_deer、告别时 phone_add nifu。生成脚本 scratchpad/later/gen_river.py。妮芙的记忆用沙漏 + 轻铃（sfx bell_soft）+ 她的本子（prop niff_notebook）表现，不计时。水下仓库里两人不说话（她说过不要隔着面罩喊）。markers 坐标都是占位 0。带 "added": true 的是补写。 10-30：飞行一结尾改成往前一冲进黑色星空、第一章结束（不再降落），原文 71–72 的降落（城市沿水道铺开……趴在操纵台上缓了一会儿）挪到 start_river 开头：晨先藏起来，河岸画面淡入时用 narr 念完、配推进器关掉 / 撞浮木的声音，晨说「行。至少到了。」以后再从舱门出来。手改的，重新跑生成脚本会丢，要一起改进去。 10-30 河岸第三版（作者要孤独感）：start_river 到晨出舱为止（设 river_ashore），晨先一个人沿河岸走一大段，走到箱子跟前才触发 bank_meet（hotspot meet_niff：trigger enter + cutscene，台词原样搬过去）；bank_cup 里补了阿汀 / 妮芙 / 晨走回飞机那边的 walk，结尾妮芙先往家那边走（river_bank_niff）。也是手改的。

objectives.en: Go back to Niff's to say goodbye
Go through Old Street to South Bridge
See if the guestbook is dry
Find the reading head in the sunken warehouse
Set the floodgates on Old Street

objectives.zh: 去高处市集借呼吸装置
objectives.en: Borrow a breathing set at the upper market
Take the footage box to Ting
Wait for the guestbook to dry

objectives.zh: 帮妮芙把漂走的东西捞上来
objectives.en: Help Niff fish out what drifted off

lines.en: Got all the parts. Back to the ship.
Got the ship number. Time to head back.
The footprints lead into the channel.

lines.zh: 影像里说：往南边去了，桥洞下面。
lines.en: The tape said: it went south, under the bridge.

lines.zh: 南桥在旧街那头，一直往右走。
lines.en: South Bridge is past the far end of Old Street. Keep going right.
The book by the window should be dry.

lines.zh: 读取头拿回来了。影像盒在桌上。
lines.en: Got the reading head. The footage box is on the table.

lines.zh: 仓库入口在水下。跟着导绳走。
lines.en: The warehouse entrance is underwater. Follow the guide rope.
Listen for which side is still bubbling.

lines.zh: 先去高处市集，借呼吸装置。
lines.en: Upper market first. Borrow a breathing set.

lines.zh: 阿汀在岸边。拿给他看看。
lines.en: Ting's on the bank. Show him.

lines.zh: 再去窗边看一眼……就一眼。
lines.en: One more look by the window... just one.
Niff's house is right on the bank.

hotspots._note: 10-31 作者：市集和旧街之间加一间楼梯间（旧街被水淹、比市集低，不能直接平移过去）。市集右头的门 → 楼梯间 → 石阶往下 → 旧街

narr.zh: 河流星。城市沿着水道铺开，细桥连着屋顶，低处的街道泛着水光。
narr.en: The river planet. The city spread out along its waterways, thin bridges linking the rooftops, the low streets shining with water.

narr.zh: 地图上的降落广场只露出一截钟楼，跑道上停着船。
narr.en: Of the landing square on the map, only the top of a clock tower showed. There were boats on the runway.

narr.zh: 晨关掉主推进器，锁住受损的管道。
narr.en: Chen cut the main thruster and locked off the damaged pipe.

narr.zh: 飞机撞散一片浮木，卡进一条窄水道。
narr.en: The plane broke through a raft of driftwood and wedged itself into a narrow channel.

narr.zh: 晨趴在操纵台上，缓了一会儿。
narr.en: Chen slumped over the console for a while.

start_river.en: Okay. At least I made it.

start_river._note: 10-30 作者：箱子后面的尾巴别另画、别凭空冒出来——妮芙原图斜着扎在箱子后面翻东西，只露出鲸鱼壳的尾巴；晨走过来远远就看得到
10-30 作者：晨在飞机那里突然出现很奇怪——舱门响了以后淡出来，再自己走两步下来

bank_meet._note: 撤掉河岸 walk_when 的墙（打捞时东西漂到下游浅滩 1250，要走过去捞）
10-30 作者：用原角色转过来——扎在箱子后面的妮芙慢慢转正、浮起来，再从箱子后面飘出来

bank_meet.en: Oh? Are you here to pick something up?
I... just fell out of the sky.

bank_meet.zh: 我刚才也掉了一箱。一起捞吧？
bank_meet.en: I just dropped a crate too. Help me fish it out?

bank_meet.zh: 那只杯子，快漂走啦。先拿它。
bank_meet.en: That cup's floating off. Get it first.
Shouldn't we get the stuff that sinks first?

bank_meet.zh: 杯子要碰台阶啦，那个会碎！
bank_meet.en: The cup's about to hit the steps. It'll break!

bank_meet.zh: 嗯，还看得见。它先坐一会儿。
bank_meet.en: Mm, I can still see it. It can sit there a while.

bank_meet.spec: 【小游戏：顺着水流打捞收藏品和修船材料。水声与碰撞声提示物品方向，漂浮轨迹提供同步视觉信息。不同物品具有不同浮力，玩家需要判断打捞顺序；错过的关键物品会停在下游浅滩，玩家可以在那里继续打捞。】

start.zh: 箱子里的东西，还在往下漂呢。
start.en: The things from my crate are still drifting down.

sank_1.zh: 没关系，它们会在底下等我的。
sank_1.en: That's okay. They'll wait for me down there.

shallows.zh: 漂下来的，都停在浅滩这儿啦。
shallows.en: Everything that drifted down got stuck here in the shallows.

give_some.zh: 沉下去的，等水退了再来接它们。
give_some.en: The ones that sank, I'll come for when the water's down.

give_all.zh: 那我得多写几张标签了。
give_all.en: Then I'd better write a few more labels.

bank_meet.en: I can use this on the ship.

bank_cup.en: Lent to Niff. Will pick up next time.

bank_cup.zh: 我呀。啊，我还没告诉你呢。
bank_cup.en: Me. Oh, I haven't told you yet.
This person calls me Miss Niff.

bank_cup.zh: 你叫妮芙就好，后面两个字不用念，
bank_cup.en: Just Niff is fine. Skip the "Miss".

bank_cup.zh: 听着像我要开始收钱了。
bank_cup.en: It sounds like I'm about to charge you.

bank_cup._note: 10-31 人和人不叠：阿汀从晨和妮芙中间的浅水里上来（原来在码头桩 872，晨去舱门得从他身上穿过去）。晨先走到舱门，阿汀再跟过去站在 river_bank_ting，妮芙等他站定再过去站在他右边，三个人一路谁也不穿过谁

bank_cup.zh: 那就上岸，别拿胳膊撑着它。它比你沉。
bank_cup.en: Then get on shore. Don't lean on it. It's heavier than you.

bank_cup.zh: 这是阿汀。渡船和水闸，都归他照看。
bank_cup.en: This is Ting. He looks after the ferries and the floodgates.

bank_cup.zh: 我管修，船各有各的主人，
bank_cup.en: I do the fixing. The boats have their own owners.

bank_cup.zh: 坏了找人家去，可别都算我头上。
bank_cup.en: If one breaks, go to them. Don't pin it all on me.

bank_cup.zh: 先晾。你现在拆，里面外面一起湿。
bank_cup.en: Let it dry. Open it now and it's wet inside and out.

bank_cup.zh: 会就好。那更该知道什么时候别动。
bank_cup.en: Good. Then you should know when to leave it alone.
All hung up. Come on, to my place.

bank_doorplate.zh: 门边一块地址，水下还有一块旧门牌。
bank_doorplate.en: An address by the door. And an old house number underwater.

bank_doorplate.zh: 两块的字，是一个人写的。
妮芙门边挂着现在的地址，水底下还有旧门牌。字一样。
bank_doorplate.en: Niff's address hangs by her door. The old house number is underwater. Same handwriting.

bank_bakery.zh: 面包店伸出一块木板，搭到对面的修补摊。
bank_bakery.en: The bakery has a plank stretched across to the repair stall.

bank_postman.zh: 邮差从屋顶的窄桥上过去了。
bank_postman.en: The mail carrier just crossed the narrow rooftop bridge.
The bag knocked the railing all the way.

bank_underwater.en: Neat paving stones under the water.
Little fish swim through a window frame.

bank_plane_parts.en: Once it's dry, I'll put it all together.

ting_chat_1.en: The ship's drying. Stop touching it.
Touching it won't make it dry faster.

ting_chat_2.en: Wait till the water goes down before you dive.

ting_chat_2.zh: 事项写齐了没有？给我看看。
ting_chat_2.en: Got everything written down? Let me see.

ting_chat_4.zh: 下回落水，挑深一点的地方。
ting_chat_4.en: Next time you land in water, pick somewhere deeper.

home_enter.en: Everything has a label.

narr.zh: 「盐，很咸，尝过了。」
narr.en: "Salt. Very salty. Tasted it."

home_enter.en: Don't try that one.

home_enter.zh: 里面以前放过盐，我写得太小啦。
home_enter.en: It used to have salt in it. I wrote too small.

narr.zh: 「你叫妮芙。这是你的家。先看桌上的本子，再出门。」
narr.en: "You are Niff. This is your home. Read the notebook on the table before you go out."

narr.zh: 「锅里有东西的时候，不要离开厨房。」
narr.en: "Don't leave the kitchen when something's on the stove."

home_enter.en: Making tea...
Boil water, add tea... oh, I skipped a step.
It's fine. Hot water's good too.

home_enter.zh: 那这碗算泡好的，不许告状哦。
home_enter.en: Then this bowl counts as tea. No telling on me.

home_enter.zh: 这个小本子，是做什么的？
home_enter.en: What's the little notebook for?

home_enter.zh: 我记不住刚发生的事情。
home_enter.en: I can't remember things that just happened.

home_enter.zh: 大概沙漏漏完一次，好多东西就找不到了。
home_enter.en: Every time the hourglass runs out, a lot of it goes missing.

home_enter.zh: 字还认得，船也会划，常走的路也认得。
home_enter.en: I can still read, still row, still know the usual paths.

home_enter.zh: 就是谁刚进过门、刚才为什么笑……
home_enter.en: It's just who came in, or why I laughed a minute ago...
I have to look it up.
Name first.

home_enter.zh: 不然一会儿只能写‘湿湿的人’，
home_enter.en: Or later I'll have to write "the soggy one",

home_enter.zh: 你看起来应该不叫这个。
home_enter.en: and you don't look like that's your name.
I'm Chen.

home_enter.zh: 晨。飞机掉进河里，帮忙捞了杯子。
home_enter.en: Chen. Ship fell in the river. Helped fish out the cup.
Still hungry.
Have you eaten?
I'm not hungry.
Mm. Then I'll leave that one.

options.zh: 我刚才是忙得没顾上饿。
options.en: I was too busy to notice I was hungry.

options.zh: 你这本子记得也太细了。

ch_bread_busy.zh: 嗯嗯，忙的时候，肚子也在忙。
ch_bread_busy.en: Mm-hm. When you're busy, your stomach's busy too.

ch_bread_sweet.zh: 有呀。这个就不甜，我尝过。
ch_bread_sweet.en: Sure. This one isn't sweet. I tasted it.

ch_bread_book.en: Too rough, and I'd lose you.

home_bread.en: Take this one. The ends are nice and crusty.

home_bread.zh: 碎屑掉桌上没关系，掉本子里要夹住的。
home_bread.en: Crumbs on the table are fine. In the notebook, they get stuck.

home_bread.zh: 我叫晨！飞机掉进河里了，
home_bread.en: I'm Chen! My ship fell in the river,

home_bread.zh: 刚才帮你捞了杯子，飞机已经拖上岸了，
home_bread.en: I helped you get the cup, the ship's on shore now,

home_bread.zh: 等一下哦，你说得比我看得快。
home_bread.en: Wait, you're talking faster than I can read.

home_bread.zh: 我两边都听，就两边都漏啦。
home_bread.en: If I listen to both, I miss both.
It says here you like these.

home_bread.zh: 妮芙记不住刚发生的事。桌上有个沙漏，漏完会响一声铃。
home_bread.en: Niff can't remember things that just happened. There's an hourglass on the table. When it runs out, a bell rings.

home_bread.zh: 铃响以后，先等她看完本子。
home_bread.en: After the bell, wait for her to read her notebook.

home_postcard.zh: 这是弥洛给的地址。你帮我看看？
home_postcard.en: Milo gave me this address. Could you take a look?

home_postcard.zh: 这个窗子……是我家以前的窗子呀。
home_postcard.en: This window... it's my house's old window.
Everyone who's stayed is written in here.

home_postcard.zh: 从森林来的客人。怕甜，会修东西。
home_postcard.en: A guest from the forest. Doesn't like sweets. Can fix things.

home_postcard.zh: 说自己只住两天，后来住了很久。
home_postcard.en: Said she'd only stay two days. Stayed a long time.

home_postcard.zh: 不要问她为什么不写回信。
home_postcard.en: Don't ask her why she never wrote back.

home_postcard.zh: 问过了，她会把茶搅很久。
home_postcard.en: Asked once. She stirred her tea for ages.

home_postcard.zh: 来客册的旧照片：袖口那块补丁，和弥洛窗边椅子上那件旧外套很像。
home_postcard.en: Old photo in the guestbook: the patch on the cuff looks like the old coat on the chair by Milo's window.

home_postcard.zh: 她刻的。说以后杯子坏啦，有人知道怎么修。
home_postcard.en: She carved it. Said if the cup ever broke, someone would know how to fix it.

home_postcard.zh: 轻一点呀，这里已经掉过字了。
home_postcard.en: Gently. Some of the writing's already come off.

home_postcard.zh: 要等它干。你瞪着它也不会快啦，我试过。
home_postcard.en: It has to dry. Staring won't make it faster. I've tried.

book_peek2.en: The edges... a little drier, maybe.

book_peek3.zh: 走来走去，地板都快被你擦干净了。
book_peek3.en: You've paced the floor almost clean.

book_peek3.zh: 来客册：看清的名字和日期，先抄下来。粘住的几页还在窗边晾。
book_peek3.en: Guestbook: copied down the names and dates I could read. The stuck pages are still drying by the window.

home_deer_msg.zh:
鹿借用：咱把旧路又走了一遍，倒树旁边那条岔路也通了。
回来叫咱，咱带你走。
还有，下回给咱画角的时候，再画大点，纸不够咱给你找。
home_deer_msg.en:
Deer borrowing: I walked the old road again. The side path by the fallen tree is open too.
Call me when you're back. I'll show you the way.
And next time you draw my antlers, make them bigger. If you run out of paper, I'll find you some.

reply.en: Got it. I'll find you when I'm back.

home_wait_talk.zh: 要是有人说会再联系你，你等了很久，还在等，你会怎么办？
home_wait_talk.en: If someone said they'd be in touch, and you waited a long time, and you're still waiting, what would you do?

home_wait_talk.zh: 我先翻翻本子呀，说不定记下来了。
home_wait_talk.en: I'd check my notebook first. Maybe I wrote it down.
But I remember she said it.
Did you write it down right then?

home_wait_talk.zh: 那说这句话的时候，你们在做什么呀？
home_wait_talk.en: Then what were you two doing when she said it?

home_drawing.zh: 森林里听到过它叫，很低很低。
home_drawing.en: I heard it call in the forest. Really, really low.

home_drawing.zh: 还有脚印，鹿说它亲眼见过——
home_drawing.en: And footprints. The deer says it saw them with its own eyes...

home_drawing.zh: 等一下哦，我好像收过这个。
home_drawing.en: Wait, I think I kept one of these.
Hm. Why'd I grab the kettle?

narr.zh: 「南桥，退水后，第七日」
narr.en: "South Bridge. Seventh day after the water went down."

narr.zh: 「拍到很大的动物，影子糊成一团，要再看一遍。」
narr.en: "Filmed a very big animal. Shadow's all blurred. Watch again."

home_drawing.zh: 倒回去。刚才那里，倒回去！

home_drawing.en: There's more after that. I know there is.

narr.zh: 「读取头松动，不要连续重试。」
narr.en: "Reading head loose. Don't keep retrying."

home_drawing.zh: 它真的坏掉的话，后面就看不到啦。
home_drawing.en: If it really breaks, we'll never see the rest.

options.en: Is there anyone here who can fix it?

options.zh: 我先不碰了，你告诉我怎么弄。
options.en: I'll leave it alone. Tell me what to do.

ch_tape_sorry.en: I could tell. You really want to see it.

ch_tape_wait.en: Okay. No pressing. Let's wrap it up first.

home_tape_wrap.zh: 这个本来就有毛病，也不能全怪你。
home_tape_wrap.en: It already had problems. It's not all your fault.

home_tape_wrap.zh: 不过下次先听我说完，好不好？
home_tape_wrap.en: But next time, let me finish first, okay?

home_tape_wrap.zh: 我会忘，讲到一半被打断，后面可能就没啦。
home_tape_wrap.en: I forget. If I get cut off halfway, the rest might be gone.
Niff has footage of the elephant.

home_hourglass.en: ...And I can't hold it back for her.

home_labels.zh: 门把手上也有：往下按，别往上提。
home_labels.en: Even the door handle has one: Push down, don't lift.

home_kitchen.zh: 所以离开厨房也没关系。
home_kitchen.en: So it's fine to leave the kitchen.

ting_footage.zh: 这种旧型号，存在旧仓库一层。
ting_footage.en: Old models like this were kept on the ground floor of the old warehouse.

ting_footage.zh: 那一层现在整个泡在水下。
现在下去，出来就不知道在哪儿了。
ting_footage.en: Go down now, and you won't know where you'll come up.
I know the way around South Bridge.

ting_footage.zh: 认路归认路，出门的事项写齐。
ting_footage.en: Knowing the way is one thing. Write down everything for the trip.

ting_footage.zh: 绳子，气瓶，回程水位，一样别少。
ting_footage.en: Rope, air tank, water level for the way back. Don't miss one.

rows.en: Water level for the way back

ting_footage.spec: 【妮芙篇探索顺序：河岸住处—高处市集—旧街水闸—水下仓库—南桥。记忆变化由关键剧情节点触发，已完成的小游戏进度保留，重复介绍的对话随剧情推进。关键任务记录始终可以查看。】

after.en: All written down. I'll hold on to the board for now.

ting_footage.zh: 要换读取头。旧仓库有，泡在水下。先去高处市集借呼吸装置。
ting_footage.en: Need a new reading head. The old warehouse has one, underwater. First, borrow a breathing set at the upper market.

market_go.en: It's livelier up here than on the bank.

market_go._note: 10-30 作者：原来妮芙在三个摊子之间来回走完才放手（54 秒动不了）。现在不锁晨：她先飘去修补摊看门边的标记，晨自己往借气瓶的摊子走，她看完会跟上来

market_breather.zh: 老样子，写好归还地点再拿。
market_breather.en: Same as always. Write where you'll return it, then take it.
Could I have another paper bag?
To split them up, so they don't all get soaked.

narr.zh: 纸袋上写着：「修船的时候吃」
narr.en: On the paper bag: "For while fixing the ship"

market_breather.en: Don't keep these next to the oil can.
The biscuits will learn funny flavors.

market_tool_stall.zh: 修补摊的工具挂了一整排。
market_tool_stall.en: A whole row of tools hangs at the repair stall.

market_tool_stall.zh: 有一把扳手，和弥洛那把很像。
market_tool_stall.en: One wrench looks a lot like Milo's.

market_bridge.en: The bridges between the roofs are all so thin.
The streets down low are all underwater.

market_keeper.en: She writes down where it goes back, every time.

oldstreet_go._note: 10-31：从楼梯间下来（楼梯间 room.json 的 portal：pan_down，渐黑 + 镜头往下）。原来接着 show 妮芙到 oldstreet_niff，淡入以后她会跳一下；with 已经把她放在晨旁边，删了

oldstreet_back._note: 10-31：回市集先上楼梯间（旧街 room.json 的 portal：pan_up，渐黑 + 镜头往上）

stairwell_jelly._note: 10-31：站到柜台左头再说话（水母在柜台右边），晨不挡住她

stairwell_jelly.zh: 下楼的话，小心第三级台阶。
stairwell_jelly.en: Going down? Mind the third step.

stairwell_jelly.zh: 我没有脚，所以一直没弄明白它哪里不对。
stairwell_jelly.en: I don't have feet, so I've never worked out what's wrong with it.

oldstreet_marks.zh: 墙上是不同年份的水位刻线。
oldstreet_marks.en: Water lines from different years on the wall.

oldstreet_marks.zh: 最旧的一条，已经被苔盖住了。
oldstreet_marks.en: The oldest one's covered in moss.

sluice.spec: 【小游戏一：水闸调节。观察水位、辨听管道声并选择开闸顺序，使旧街踏步露出。错误操作只让水位回到上一个稳定状态，不损失剧情物品。防水板保留已经验证的结果，避免玩家与妮芙重复试错。】

intro.en: The diagram only shows the pipes.

intro.zh: 闸轮上的牌子，掉了两块。
intro.en: Two of the gate wheel plates are missing.

intro.zh: 大的先别转呀，这边还在咕噜咕噜。
intro.en: Don't turn the big one yet. This side's still gurgling.
Once it stops bubbling, we'll try.

first_set.zh: 等一下，先把刻度记到板上嘛。
first_set.en: Wait, write the setting on the board first.

first_set.zh: 我等一下要是忘了，会想再转一次。
first_set.en: If I forget later, I'll want to turn it again.

second_set.zh: 第二道，刻度在第三格。你核对一下。
second_set.en: Second gate, third notch. Check it for me.

wrong_1.en: The water surged up, then fell back.
Not this notch. I'll put an X.

dry_1.zh: 转得动，可这根管子一点声音都没有。
dry_1.en: It turns, but this pipe doesn't make a sound.

already.zh: 这道记过啦，板上写着呢。
already.en: We did this one already. It's on the board.

big_early.zh: 还在冒泡呢，大的再等等。
big_early.en: Still bubbling. The big one has to wait.

look_pipes.zh: 咕噜声是从这根管子里来的。
look_pipes.en: The gurgling's coming from this pipe.

look_marks_0.zh: 水还停在最上面那条刻线。
look_marks_0.en: The water's still up at the top line.

look_marks_1.en: The water's down to the next line.

look_marks_2.zh: 又退了一条。踏步快露出来了。
look_marks_2.en: Down another line. The steps are nearly out.

oldstreet_signs.zh: 上下两层，门上是同一个店名。
oldstreet_signs.en: Two levels, the same shop name over both doors.
On the lower one, the paint's all faded.

oldstreet_corner.en: You used to be able to buy jam here.

oldstreet_corner.zh: 脚还记得呢，店已经不在啦。
oldstreet_corner.en: My feet still remember. The shop's gone, though.

oldstreet_corner.zh: 旧街的墙上有一排身高刻线。最上面的红线是洪水那天，比妮芙高很多。
oldstreet_corner.en: A row of height marks on an Old Street wall. The red line at the top is the day of the flood, far above Niff's head.

niff_chat_old.zh: 下水的时候，跟着导绳走哦。
niff_chat_old.en: When we go under, follow the guide rope.

rows.en: Way back: toward the exit light

warehouse_go.zh: 两个人的名字，来取什么，回来往哪边。
warehouse_go.en: Both our names, what we're getting, which way back.

narr.zh: 防水板：「跟着导绳走」
narr.en: Waterproof Board: "Follow the guide rope"

warehouse_go.zh: 我看着像要乱走的时候，就给我看这个。
warehouse_go.en: If I look like I'm wandering off, show me this.

warehouse_go.zh: 不要隔着面罩喊我，听不清的。
warehouse_go.en: Don't shout at me through the mask. I can't hear it.

warehouse_go._note: 10-30 作者：进仓库这段等太久（原来晨自动走过整片开阔海底才放手）。下水以后就放手，晨自己游到箱子跟前触发 warehouse_in（hotspot wh_in）

narr.zh: 「借来的」
narr.en: "Borrowed"

narr.zh: 「还不知道是谁的，先放好」
narr.en: "Don't know whose yet. Keep safe."

tag.zh: 一包密封圈。泡过水，没裂。
tag.en: A pack of seals. Soaked, but not cracked.
Knobs, a coil of fine wire.

label.zh: 什么都不拿，顺着导绳回去
label.en: Take nothing, follow the rope back

warehouse_in.spec: 【小游戏二：水下仓库。玩家利用浮箱改变柜子的受力位置，拉开堵住内门的家具，再按设备标签找到读取头。导绳、出口灯和明确的绳结提供导航，气量不设置紧迫倒计时。完成主目标后，可顺路取回少量旧物和修船零件。】

narr.zh: 记录下面压着一张手绘图，「开闸」被圈了起来：
narr.en: Under the log is a hand-drawn map. "Open the gate" is circled:

narr.zh: 「再看一遍。阿汀已经确认，船上还有人。」
narr.en: "Read it again. Ting has confirmed there are still people on the boat."

narr.zh: 「箱子拿不完。不要为了回来拿箱子，再把闸关上。」
narr.en: "We can't take all the crates. Don't come back for them and close the gate again."

narr.zh: 「借来的」
narr.en: "Borrowed"

home_coat.zh: 这个是我开的呀？
home_coat.en: I opened this?

home_coat.zh: 是我当时忘了关吗？
home_coat.en: Did I forget to close it back then?

home_coat.zh: 当时水一直往渡船那边涨，
home_coat.en: Back then, the water kept rising toward the ferries.

home_coat.zh: 得有人把泄水门打开。
home_coat.en: Someone had to open the sluice gate.

home_coat.zh: 我们商量过，你也确认过。
home_coat.en: We talked it over. You checked it too.

home_coat.zh: 最后是你守在门边，
home_coat.en: In the end, you stayed by the gate,

home_coat.zh: 怕水位一变，门自己合上。
home_coat.en: in case the water shifted and it swung shut.

home_coat.zh: 那你以前为什么说，
home_coat.en: Then why did you always say

home_coat.zh: 是没来得及搬呀？
home_coat.en: there wasn't time to move things?

home_coat.zh: 最开始几次，你读到记录，
home_coat.en: The first few times you read the log,

home_coat.zh: 马上就要下去找东西。
home_coat.en: you wanted to go straight down for your things.

home_coat.zh: 那时水位还高，我一遍遍拦住你。
home_coat.en: The water was still high. I stopped you again and again.

home_coat.zh: 后来我把那页单独收好，
home_coat.en: After that, I put that page away on its own,

home_coat.zh: 只告诉你洪水来得太快，
home_coat.en: and just told you the flood came too fast,

home_coat.zh: 那些箱子都留在了屋里。
home_coat.en: and the crates got left inside.

home_coat.zh: 可我知道它们会湿，对不对？
home_coat.en: But I knew they'd get wet, didn't I?

home_coat.zh: 是。
home_coat.en: Yes.

home_coat.zh: 原来我想过的，
home_coat.en: So I did think about it.

home_coat.zh: 知道会泡湿，还是把箱子留在了那里。
home_coat.en: I knew they'd be soaked, and I left them there anyway.

home_coat.zh: 以后放我这里吧。
home_coat.en: Leave it with me from now on.

home_coat.zh: 要不然我每次看见那些箱子，
home_coat.en: Otherwise every time I see those crates,

home_coat.zh: 都以为自己又弄丢东西了。
home_coat.en: I'll think I lost something again.

home_coat.zh: 这里有个小盒子。
home_coat.en: There's a little box here.

home_coat.zh: 里面有几颗玻璃珠，绿色那颗最圆。
home_coat.en: A few glass marbles inside. The green one's the roundest.

home_coat.zh: 放到眼前，整扇窗都会变成绿色。
home_coat.en: Hold it to your eye and the whole window turns green.

home_coat.zh: 知道当时为什么开闸……
home_coat.en: Knowing why you opened the gate...

home_coat.zh: 会不会好受一点？
home_coat.en: does that make it any easier?

home_coat.zh: 会呀。至少我知道，自己当时想救船上的人。
home_coat.en: It does. At least I know I was trying to save the people on the boat.

home_coat.zh: 可是我还是想把它找回来嘛。
home_coat.en: But I still want to find it again.

home_coat_b.zh: 那排柜子在哪儿，我记得。
home_coat_b.en: I remember where that row of cabinets is.

home_coat_b.zh: 水位合适的时候，可以再一起去找。
home_coat_b.en: When the water's right, we can go look together.

home_coat_b.zh: 拿回来的这些还没晾干呢，
home_coat_b.en: What we brought back isn't even dry yet.

home_coat_b.zh: 再捞一堆，今晚我就没地方睡了。
home_coat_b.en: Fish out another pile and I'll have nowhere to sleep tonight.

home_coat_b.zh: 那以前为什么说，没来得及搬？
home_coat_b.en: Then why was I told there wasn't time to move things?

narr.zh: 封面写着：「不要替我收走」
narr.en: The cover says: "Don't put this away for me"

home_coat_b.en: Made it to the river city.

home_coat_b.zh: 我老记着她最后没回我，前面我们到底说过什么，反倒一直没往回看。
home_coat_b.en: I keep thinking about how she never wrote back. I never scrolled up to see what we'd said before that.

tape_fix.zh: 这个也弄好吧，你都看它好几次啦。
tape_fix.en: Let's fix this too. You keep looking at it.

tape_fix.zh: 我可以再等等。
tape_fix.en: I can wait.

tape_fix.zh: 我知道呀。可现在也可以修嘛。
tape_fix.en: I know. But we could fix it now, too.

tape_fix.zh: 你帮我按着，我来接这根线，
tape_fix.en: Hold this down for me. I'll connect the wire,

tape_fix.zh: 不然一松手，它又缩回去。
tape_fix.en: or it'll slip back the moment I let go.

tape_fix.zh: 别站那儿！
tape_fix.en: Don't stand there!

tape_fix.zh: 往南边去了。
tape_fix.en: It went south.

tape_fix.zh: 看到了吗，桥洞下面！
tape_fix.en: See it? Under the bridge!

tape_fix.zh: 这次耳朵、鼻子都拍到了。
tape_fix.en: This time it got the ears and the nose.

tape_fix.zh: 这里少了一点诶。会不会疼呀？
tape_fix.en: There's a bit missing here. Does it hurt?

tape_fix.zh: 左耳缺口，可以辨认。
tape_fix.en: Notch in the left ear. Recognizable.

tape_fix.zh: 你在等什么呀？
tape_fix.en: What are you waiting for?

tape_fix.zh: 有人说过，找到大象就会再联系我。
tape_fix.en: Someone told me: find the elephant, and we'll talk again.

tape_fix.zh: 可你现在已经看见大象了呀。
tape_fix.en: But you've seen the elephant now.

tape_fix.zh: 也许要真的到它旁边才算，隔着画面不算吧。
tape_fix.en: Maybe it only counts if I'm right next to it. Not through a screen.

tape_fix.zh: 不知道。画面太远了。
tape_fix.en: I don't know. The picture's too far away.

tape_fix.zh: 它平时就住在桥底下吗？
tape_fix.en: Does it usually live under the bridge?

tape_fix.zh: 它刚才是在拉绳子。
tape_fix.en: It was pulling on a rope just now.

tape_fix.zh: 嗯，把灯都拉歪啦。
tape_fix.en: Mm, it pulled the lamps all crooked.

tape_fix.zh: 也可能是想从那边上来。
tape_fix.en: Or maybe it was trying to climb out there.

tape_fix.zh: 你看，这里滑下去了。
tape_fix.en: Look, it slipped here.

label.zh: 它在拉缆绳，把浮灯拉歪了。
label.en: It's pulling the cable. The floating lamps went crooked.
It seems to want to climb out by the bridge.

label.zh: 左耳缺了一块。不知道疼不疼。
label.en: A piece of its left ear is missing. I wonder if it hurts.

el_rope.zh: 它用鼻子拉缆绳，浮灯一整排都歪了。
el_rope.en: It pulled the cable with its nose. A whole row of floating lamps went crooked.

el_climb.zh: 它好像想从桥边上岸，鼻子搭上石沿，又滑下去了。
el_climb.en: It seemed to want to climb out by the bridge. Got its nose on the stone ledge, then slid back down.

el_ear.zh: 左耳缺了一块。不知道什么时候留下的，也不知道疼不疼。
el_ear.en: A piece of its left ear is missing. No idea when it happened, or if it hurts.

tape_sound.zh: 再来一次嘛，我刚刚躲掉了。
tape_sound.en: Again. I jumped and missed it.
So that's how low it is.

tape_sound.zh: 像从桌子底下传出来的。
tape_sound.en: Like it's coming from under the table.
Wow, it really has a voice!

tape_sound.zh: 刚才我们一起，把声音修好了。
tape_sound.en: Just now, we fixed the sound together.

tape_sound.zh: 这里能不能再写，我们都很高兴？
tape_sound.en: Can you also write here that we were both happy?

tape_sound.zh: 可以呀。以后我就知道，这里要高兴一下。
tape_sound.en: Sure. Then later I'll know to be happy here.

guestbook.en: It opens now. The last few pages...

guestbook.zh: 弥洛的朋友，洪水以后又留了一阵。
guestbook.en: Milo's friend stayed a while after the flood.
Helped fix pumps, fish things out.

guestbook.zh: 后来跟着补给船，去了云层星。
guestbook.en: Then went to the Cloud Planet on a supply ship.

guestbook.zh: 走的那天，她把借来的杯子交给我，
guestbook.en: The day she left, she gave me the cup she'd borrowed,
and said to keep it for her. She'd pick it up next time.

guestbook.zh: 给弥洛的信，投进了北岸的旧邮箱。
guestbook.en: Her letter to Milo went in the old mailbox on the north bank.
There was a slip of paper inside, too,

guestbook.zh: 写着新住址和通讯号码。
guestbook.en: with her new address and contact number.
The old mailbox on the north bank?
The next flood washed it away.
Nobody got the letters out in time.

guestbook.zh: 来客册：她离开的日期，补给船的船名。抄下来了。
guestbook.en: Guestbook: the date she left, the supply ship's name. Copied them down.
You have to tell her this.

guestbook.zh: 等一封没收到的信，会等错地方的。
guestbook.en: If you wait for a letter that never came, you wait in the wrong place.

options.zh: 我会把日期和船名一起带回去。
options.en: I'll take the date and the ship's name back with me.

options.zh: 杯子也能让我带去给她看吗？
options.en: Can I take the cup to show her too?

ch_letter_bring.en: Mm. Don't copy the ship's name wrong.

ch_letter_wrote.en: She did. It just never got there.

guestbook_cup.zh: 我再给你画一下杯底的记号吧。
guestbook_cup.en: Let me trace the mark on the bottom of the cup for you.
The cup stays here for now.

guestbook_cup.zh: 人家说了要来拿，我也答应啦。
guestbook_cup.en: She said she'd come for it, and I promised.

guestbook_cup.zh: 要是以后改了主意，得先写下来。
guestbook_cup.en: If I ever change my mind, I have to write it down first.

south_go.zh: 退水以后，桥露出来的比影像里多。
south_go.en: With the water down, more of the bridge shows than in the footage.

south_go.zh: 那些像栏杆的，原来是屋顶上的装饰。
south_go.en: What looked like railings are actually roof ornaments.
...No, the lamppost isn't on this side.

south_go.zh: 南桥：走错了一个桥洞。重新标了灯柱。
south_go.en: South Bridge: went under the wrong arch. Marked the lamppost again.

south_go.spec: 【小游戏三：还原拍摄位置。玩家对照影像里的桥洞、灯柱与浮灯方向，找到正确的观察点，再结合当前水位确认动物经过的水道。完成后显露旧运输水道的入口，不依赖快速反应或记忆倒计时。】

start.en: The footage was shot from this side of the bridge.

start.zh: 灯柱和桥洞，要一起对上。
start.en: The lamppost and the arch have to line up at the same time.

aligned.zh: 那时候的水，比现在高这么多。
aligned.en: The water back then was this much higher.

ask.zh: 浮灯都往一边歪……它是从哪个桥洞过去的？
ask.en: The floating lamps all lean one way... which arch did it go through?

wrong_southbridge_arch_wrong.zh: 刚才找的就是这个，不对。
wrong_southbridge_arch_wrong.en: That's the one I tried before. Not it.

wrong_southbridge_arch_far.en: The lamps weren't leaning this way.

right.zh: 灯往这边歪，灰影也是往这儿去的。
right.en: The lamps lean this way. The gray shape went this way too.

south_go.en: The scrape marks are so high up.

south_go.zh: 它要是踩过来，我得早点让路呀。
south_go.en: If it steps this way, I'd better move early.

south_go.zh: 南桥桥洞的脚印，和森林里的速写差不多大，落点也像。是不是同一只，还待确认。
south_go.en: The footprints under South Bridge are about the size of my sketch from the forest, spaced alike too. Same one? Still to be confirmed.

south_lamp.zh: 影像里那排浮灯，挂的就是这根灯柱。
south_lamp.en: That row of floating lamps in the footage hung from this lamppost.

south_ornament.zh: 从下面看，是别人家的屋顶。

niff_chat_south.en: What were we looking for again?
Oh, the elephant. South Bridge. Right, right.

south_dock.zh: 航线图掉了，墙上只剩几块编号牌。
south_dock.en: The route map's fallen. Only a few number plates are left on the wall.

narr.zh: 旧装卸记录：一行一个编号，后面写着船和去向。
narr.en: Old loading records: one number per line, then the ship and where it went.

dock_plates.spec: 水道尽头是一处废弃货台，墙上的航线图已经脱落，只剩几块编号牌。玩家把编号牌与旧装卸记录对应，能确认这里曾经停靠前往云层星的运输船。

narr.zh: 「07　补给船　去往东岸」
narr.en: "07  Supply ship  To the east bank"

narr.zh: 「12　运输船　去往云层星」
narr.en: "12  Transport ship  To the Cloud Planet"

dock_plate_12.en: I found the ship it took.

dock_plate_12.zh: 至少这张照片里，它正要上去。
dock_plate_12.en: In this photo, at least, it's about to board.
What are they coaxing it with?

dock_plate_12.zh: 这么长一串，会不会没走到上面就吃完啦。
dock_plate_12.en: That's a long string. What if it eats it all before it reaches the top?

dock_plate_12.zh: 我一开始就想赶紧找到，
dock_plate_12.en: At first I just wanted to find it fast,
so that person would answer me.

dock_plate_12.zh: 现在还想看看，大象到那边以后住哪儿，
dock_plate_12.en: Now I also want to see where it lives over there.

dock_plate_12.zh: 这里的桥这么低，转个身都难。
dock_plate_12.en: The bridges here are so low. It could barely turn around.

dock_plate_12.zh: 不要刚找到就急着拍完走掉。
dock_plate_12.en: Don't just snap a photo and leave the minute you find it.

dock_plate_12.zh: 照片还是要拍的。清楚一点。
dock_plate_12.en: I'm still taking a photo. A clear one.
Okay. You could get one of it eating, too.

dock_plate_12.zh: 货台的旧照片：它在上坡板，左耳缺了一角。背面的船号和航线图的终点对得上。
dock_plate_12.en: Old photo from the dock: it's on the ramp, a corner missing from its left ear. The ship number on the back matches the end of the route map.

narr.zh: 日记前面，最初那句还在：「找到以后拍给她看」
narr.en: Further back in the journal, the old line is still there: "Take a photo for her when I find it"

dock_plate_12.zh: 这里的人后来还见过它吗？
dock_plate_12.en: Did anyone here ever see it again?

narr.zh: 「21　渡船　去往下游船坞」
narr.en: "21  Ferry  To the downstream boatyard"

south_back._note: 10-30：原来接着把妮芙 show 到旧街左头（70），再让她游 1000 多像素到钩子这里，晨干等 15 秒；fade_to 的 with 已经把她放在晨旁边

south_back.zh: 这个原来挂在我的小船上。
south_back.en: This used to hang on my little boat.

south_back.zh: 回来的时候摇一摇，岸上就知道了。
south_back.en: Ring it on the way back, and the bank knows you're home.
Mm. Now it sounds like itself.

south_back.zh: 挂在飞机里面吧，晃起来就能听见。
south_back.en: Hang it in your ship. You'll hear it when it sways.

south_back.zh: 现在阿汀一看水面，就知道是谁回来了。
south_back.en: These days Ting just looks at the water and knows who's back.

south_back.zh: 再摇铃，阿汀又该嫌吵了。
south_back.en: If I ring it too, Ting will grumble about the noise.

south_back.zh: 送给你啦，以后就是你的了。

narr.zh: 标签：「已经送给晨，不用还」
narr.en: Label: "Given to Chen. No need to return."

south_back.zh: 妮芙送的铜铃。标签背面画了一架小飞机，机翼歪得和我那架差不多。
south_back.en: A copper bell from Niff. On the back of the label, a little ship, its wings as crooked as mine.

plane_fix.en: ...When you screw the joint back in,

plane_fix.zh: 那我还是念嘛，万一你今天刚好忘掉呢。
plane_fix.en: I'll keep saying it anyway. What if today's the day you forget?

plane_fix.zh: 这袋是烧的。别把吃的也混进去。
plane_fix.en: This bag's for burning. Don't mix your food in.
...The biscuits are on the other side.

plane_fix.zh: 飞机修好了。阿汀给了一袋晾干的浮木。
plane_fix.en: The ship's fixed. Ting gave me a bag of dried driftwood.

farewell.zh: 这次先放茶啦。本子上写着。
farewell.en: Tea first this time. It's in the notebook.
Chen is going to the Cloud Planet to find the elephant.

farewell.zh: 走之前跟我说过再见啦。
farewell.en: Said goodbye to me before leaving.

farewell.zh: 他的围裙上，还有一块补丁。
farewell.en: Ting's apron has a patch, too.

narr.zh: 新标签：「你可以用这个去找大象啦。要是找到了，记得回来告诉我，一定要写下来哦。」
narr.en: New label: "You can use this to find the elephant. If you find it, come back and tell me. And write it down."

narr.zh: 瓶子上的标签：「晨来过的那条河」
narr.en: Label on the bottle: "The river Chen came to"

farewell.en: A bottle of water? Won't it leak?

options.en: I'll write down what I see, a little at a time.

options.zh: 画得不好，你也得认出来。
options.en: Even if it's badly drawn, you have to recognize it.

options.zh: 下次别先把我写成湿湿的人。
options.en: Next time, don't write me down as the soggy one.

ch_bye_draw.zh: 认得出来呀。有补丁的是阿汀。
ch_bye_draw.en: I can tell. The one with the patch is Ting.

ch_bye_wet.zh: 那要看你下次湿不湿啦。
ch_bye_wet.en: Depends on whether you're soggy next time.

farewell_b.zh: 那你把名字写大一点嘛。
我翻本子的时候，一眼就能看见。
farewell_b.en: So I'll spot it right away when I flip through.
Now it looks like a kettle.

farewell_b.zh: 不是水壶。鼻子本来就是这么长。
farewell_b.en: It's not a kettle. The nose is supposed to be that long.

farewell_b.zh: 你看，耳朵在这里，腿在这里……
妮芙那一页：晨要去云层星找大象。走之前说过再见了。
farewell_b.en: Niff's page: Chen is going to the Cloud Planet to find the elephant. Said goodbye before leaving.

narr.zh: 「晨，飞机已经修好，要去找大象。」
narr.en: "Chen. Ship fixed. Off to find the elephant."

farewell_phone.zh: 这样你发消息的时候，我就知道是你啦。
farewell_phone.en: This way, when you message me, I'll know it's you.

farewell_phone.zh: 要写清楚哦，光发一个‘到了’，我会想好久的。
farewell_phone.en: Write it clearly. If you just send "made it", I'll puzzle over it for ages.

depart.zh: 妮芙今天把茶叶放对了。
depart.en: Niff got the tea right today.

depart.zh: 南桥的船号。往云层星去。
depart.en: The ship number from South Bridge. Bound for the Cloud Planet.

niff_chat_bank.zh: 你的飞机好像在想事情。
niff_chat_bank.en: Your ship looks like it's thinking.

niff_chat_home.en: Oh, Chen. The one who fished out the cup.

niff_chat_market.zh: 借的东西，都要写还到哪里。
niff_chat_market.en: Anything borrowed, you write down where it goes back.
Or I'll find it a new home.

niff_chat_late.en: When it is, say goodbye first.
